401920373.summary: UC San Diego is a -2400 favorite (-19.5) at home, where it has won seven straight against unranked teams (Pick Dawgz); YouWager picks the Tritons straight up. Doc's Sports takes Texas Southern on the spread. Both defenses have been leaky: Texas Southern allows 93.0 a game, UCSD gave up 120 to Utah State.
401920373.pick: UC San Diego to win (YouWager; -2400 favorite); Texas Southern +19.5 (Doc's Sports); Over 156.5 (Pick Dawgz)
